# reports/ — evaluation reports

**User layer.** One markdown report per offer evaluated. Generated by `modes/oferta.md` (eventually `agents/evaluator/`).

## File naming

```
{###}-{company-slug}-{YYYY-MM-DD}.md
```

- `###` — sequential 3-digit, zero-padded. Pick `max existing + 1`.
- `company-slug` — lowercase, hyphen-separated company name.
- `YYYY-MM-DD` — the evaluation date.

Codex reviews (Phase 3) write to:
```
{###}-{company-slug}-{YYYY-MM-DD}-codex-review.md
```

## Required report header

Every report MUST include:

- `**Score:** X.X/5`
- `**URL:**` link to the JD
- `**PDF:**` link if a CV was generated
- `**Legitimacy:** {tier}` (Block G output)

`node verify-pipeline.mjs` enforces this.

## Report blocks (A–G)

A. Role fit · B. Compensation · C. Level · D. Market · E. Mitigations · F. Interview plan · G. Posting legitimacy.

## Related

- The agent that writes reports → `modes/oferta.md` (today) / `agents/evaluator/` (after Phase 4)
- Pattern analysis across all reports → `agents/pattern-analyst/` (today: `analyze-patterns.mjs`)
